At TopBlogTech.com ("we", "our", or "us"), accessible from https://topblogtech.com/, the privacy of our visitors is of paramount importance. This Privacy Policy document outlines the types of personal data and technical information collected, recorded, and processed by TopBlogTech.com, and explains how we protect your privacy rights under applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), UK GDPR, and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA).

1. Information We Collect

TopBlogTech collects information in two ways: information you provide directly and technical information collected automatically during your visit:

  • Direct Interactions: When you contact our editorial team via email or submit a form, we may collect your name, email address, and message contents.
  • Log Files & Technical Identifiers: Like most modern publications, our servers automatically log standard network information when you visit. This includes your IP address, browser user-agent string, Internet Service Provider (ISP), referring/exit URLs, date/time stamps, and clicked pages. These records are strictly used for network security, troubleshooting, and diagnosing server issues, and are not linked to personally identifiable information.

2. Cookies & Web Beacons

TopBlogTech uses cookies to preserve user preferences, monitor site performance, and ensure smooth navigation. Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your browser. You can configure your browser settings to reject cookies or notify you when a cookie is sent. However, disabling certain functional cookies may impact your browsing experience.

3. Web Analytics (Google Analytics 4)

We use Google Analytics 4 (GA4, Measurement ID: G-SNDLMK8H9E) to understand aggregate audience trends, popular article categories, and reader engagement metrics. GA4 collects anonymized telemetry, including masked IP addresses and device characteristics. Google provides a browser add-on allowing users to opt out of Google Analytics tracking across the web: Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

4. Advertising & Third-Party Technologies

TopBlogTech is designed for monetized digital publishing. In the future, we may display advertising served by Google AdSense and authorized third-party ad networks. These vendors may use cookies, device identifiers, and similar technologies to measure ad effectiveness and serve relevant advertisements based on past visits to this and other websites across the Internet.

Users located in the European Economic Area (EEA), United Kingdom (UK), and Switzerland are provided with a Google-certified Consent Management Platform (CMP) conforming to the IAB Europe Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF v2.2) to manage their personalized advertising and cookie consent choices. You can review Google's advertising privacy policies at Google Advertising Privacy & Terms.

5. Affiliate Links & External Outbound Links

Certain links on TopBlogTech.com are affiliate links. If you click on an affiliate link and make a purchase, the merchant may set a tracking cookie to attribute the referral to us. Please review our Affiliate Disclosure for full details. TopBlogTech contains links to external websites whose privacy practices we do not control; we encourage you to review the privacy statements of every site you visit.

6. Data Retention & Security

We retain log data only as long as necessary for technical security and operational monitoring. We maintain industry-standard security safeguards—including TLS/SSL 256-bit encryption, strict file permissions, and directory browsing protection—to prevent unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure of collected data.

7. Your Rights Under GDPR & CCPA/CPRA

Depending on your jurisdiction, you have specific legal rights regarding your personal data, including the right to request access, rectification, portability, or erasure of your information, and the right to object to or restrict processing. We do not sell or share personal data for monetary consideration. To exercise any of your data protection rights, please contact us at privacy@topblogtech.com.

8. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We reserve the right to update this policy periodically to reflect operational, technological, or legal changes. Updates will be posted on this page with an updated modification date.

1. Who Runs This Website

TopBlogTech.com is a personal website founded in 2026 and run by one person, Deepak Pandey, in India, who decides how the limited personal data described below is used and is responsible for it. There is no company, team or office behind the site. For any privacy question, email contact@topblogtech.com.

2. Information We Collect

  • Messages you send us: If you use the form on our Contact Us page or email us, we receive your name, email address and the content of your message. The contact form sends your message to the site owner by email. It does not use a third-party form service and does not store submissions in the website database.
  • Analytics data: Usage information collected through Google Analytics 4, as described in Section 4.
  • Delivery and security data: Cloudflare (Section 5) and our web hosting provider process your IP address and standard request details (such as browser user agent, requested page, referring page, date and time) to deliver pages and protect the site. Web servers typically keep standard access logs for troubleshooting and security.
  • Login security: The site uses the Loginizer security plugin, which records the IP address of failed login attempts to the WordPress admin area so that brute-force attacks can be blocked. Ordinary visitors never need to log in.

We do not offer visitor accounts, a newsletter or public comments, so no personal data is collected through those features.

3. Cookies

Cookies are small text files stored by your browser. The following cookies may be used on this site:

  • Google Analytics cookies (such as _ga and _ga_<ID>), used to distinguish visits for aggregate statistics. They are only set where analytics storage is allowed (see Section 4).
  • Cloudflare security cookies such as __cf_bm, which Cloudflare uses to identify automated (bot) traffic. According to Cloudflare’s cookie documentation, this cookie expires after 30 minutes of inactivity.
  • WordPress login cookies, which are set only for the site administrator while logged in. Regular visitors do not receive them.

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. The articles remain readable without cookies.

4. Google Analytics 4

We use Google Analytics 4 (Measurement ID G-SNDLMK8H9E), loaded with Google’s gtag.js script, to understand in aggregate which pages are read and how visitors find the site. Google Analytics receives information such as the pages you view, approximate location, device and browser type, and the referring website. We do not use it to identify individual visitors.

Visitors in the European Economic Area (EEA), the United Kingdom and Switzerland: we use Google Consent Mode with consent defaults set to "denied". While consent is denied, Google tags do not read or write analytics cookies, but they may still send limited cookieless signals (such as a timestamp, browser user agent and referrer) that Google uses for modelling, as described in Google’s Consent Mode documentation. The site does not yet show a consent banner, so these "denied" defaults currently remain in place for visitors in these regions. For users in the EU, UK and Switzerland, Google states that Google Analytics does not log or store their individual IP addresses.

Analytics data is kept according to the data-retention setting of our Google Analytics property. You can opt out of Google Analytics on all websites with the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on. To learn more, see How Google uses information from sites or apps that use its services.

5. Cloudflare (Content Delivery and Security)

The site is delivered through Cloudflare, a content delivery and security network. Cloudflare processes visitors’ IP addresses and request data to serve cached pages, keep the site available and block malicious or automated traffic, and it may set security cookies such as __cf_bm (see Section 3).

6. Advertising (Not Currently Active)

TopBlogTech.com does not currently display advertising, and Google AdSense is not active on the site. If the site is approved for Google AdSense in the future, Google and its advertising partners may use cookies and similar technologies to serve and measure ads, including personalised ads based on your visits to this and other websites. Before that happens, we will update this policy and, for visitors in the EEA, UK and Switzerland, use a Google-certified consent management platform so that you can make your choices. See Google Advertising Privacy & Terms for how Google handles advertising data.

7. Affiliate and External Links

TopBlogTech.com does not currently contain affiliate links. If affiliate links are added in the future, they will be marked and explained in our Affiliate Disclosure, and merchants may then set their own tracking cookies when you click them. Our articles link to external websites, such as official documentation, whose privacy practices we do not control; please review the privacy policies of the sites you visit.

8. How We Use and Share Information

We use personal data only to reply to your messages, understand overall readership, and keep the site secure. We do not sell or rent personal data. The service providers involved are Google (analytics), Cloudflare (delivery and security), our web hosting provider and our email provider. These providers may process data in countries other than your own, including the United States.

9. Data Retention

Messages sent by email or through the contact form are kept only as long as needed to handle your enquiry and any follow-up. Failed-login records are kept by the security plugin for its configured period. Analytics data is retained as described in Section 4.

10. Security

The site is served over HTTPS, protected by Cloudflare, and the admin login is protected against brute-force attempts. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

11. Your Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct or delete personal data we hold about you, to object to or restrict its use, and to withdraw consent. To make a request, email contact@topblogtech.com with the subject "Privacy request". We will respond within the time required by applicable law. You may also have the right to complain to your local data protection authority.

12. Children

This website is intended for a general adult audience and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has sent us personal data, please contact us and we will delete it.

13. Changes to This Policy

We will update this policy when our practices change, for example if advertising is introduced. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised.
